title: Physical file digest memo
description: A file whose identity (device, inode, size, modification and change time) is unchanged has the digest it had when it was hashed, so a retry of a layer of the churn policy, and a restarted process, hash only what a peer edited. A digest is remembered only when the file had been quiet for the racy window before the hash started, so a rewrite within the clock granularity of its own observation is never mistaken for the old bytes. The memo is shared by every owner of one directory in a process and persisted there as one file.
